newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk treasury buys 45.48 trln Dec 10, 1997 bills.
newsitem.headline: Turk treasury buys 45.48 trln Dec 10, 1997 bills.

text.p: The Turkish treasury bought 45.48 trillion lira of December 10, 1997 paper back at an average yield of 81.54 percent (excluding witholding tax), in its first reverse auction, the central bank announced on Monday.
Total demand for the auction was 115.9 trillion lira and the minimum rate was 87.50 percent.
The treasury will pay banks 35.6 trillion lira for its reverse auction on Wednesday.
A total of 380.1 trillion lira worth of outstanding bills will mature on December 10.
The treasury will auction on Tuesday 357-day t-bills with Wednesday settlement, when banks will pay 56 trillion lira to the central bank for its matured repos.
